description.narrative: Stöd till det nationella programmet för sub-nationel demokratisk utveckling och dess tre-åriga implementeringsplan IP3 2011-2013 under perioden april 2011 - september 2012.
Support to the National Programme for Sub-National Democratic Development and its three-year Implementation Plan IP3 2011-2013 for the period April 2011- September 2012.

sector.narrative: Decentralisation and support to subnational government

description.narrative: The objective was to provide support to the decentralisation reform in Cambodia. The contribution supported the IP3 1 phase, including support to policy and capacity development, providing the basis for the decentralisation of services and local democratic development. The contribution contained an earmarked support to the District/Municipality fund of a total of 4 million USD, , i.e. 42,710,000 SEK. Due to lacking clarifications regarding procedures for the use of funds, the disbursement from the National Treasury to local district/municipality accounts were delayed, and the spending was delayed until 2015-2017. In December 2017, an amount of KHR 700,814,933 remained, to be reimbursed to Sida. The amount was confirmed in a, by Sida, commissioned external audit ("Report of Factual Findings for the D/M funds for the period from 30 September 2012 to 30 November 2017", Moore Stephens, April 2018).
